accounts.plainLanguage: Card sales waiting to be deposited.

accounts.plainLanguage: Customer invoices that have not been collected.

accounts.plainLanguage: GST paid that may qualify as an input tax credit.

accounts.name: Inventory
accounts.plainLanguage: Product cost currently held for sale.

accounts.plainLanguage: Long-lived equipment owned by the business.

accounts.plainLanguage: Approved supplier bills that remain unpaid.

accounts.plainLanguage: Payroll deductions and employer amounts still payable.

accounts.plainLanguage: Funds the owner contributed to the business.

accounts.plainLanguage: Funds withdrawn by the owner; not an operating expense.

accounts.name: Interest expense
accounts.plainLanguage: Financing cost, separate from principal repayment.

thirteenWeekCashFlow.boundary: Opening cash is the verified balance as of the report date. Actual movements are shown for context and are not added to that balance again. Expected receipts never increase purchasing capacity. Foreign-currency or undated vendor commitments block purchasing capacity until reviewed.
